product.title: Caslon NG
product.body:
Caslon NG is Newglyph’s reinterpretation of the classic Caslon, designed by Ian Party to merge timeless elegance with modern adaptability. The complete family includes 180 styles, organized into 10 bundles—Caslon NG and Caslon NG BIG—each with 8 weights across Extra Condensed, Condensed, Normal, Expanded, and Extra Expanded, with italics included.
The full family is available in two variable fonts, allowing smooth interpolation across weights and widths.
Available in OTF and Woff2 formats, Caslon NG is a versatile typographic system for print, editorial, and branding projects.
product.seo_title: Caslon NG – Classic Serif Typeface Reimagined
product.seo_description: Caslon NG by Ian Party. 180 styles, 10 bundles, 2 variable fonts, OTF/Woff2. Elegant serif for editorial, branding & display design.
